title: Good slicing radius and subsequence: Fatou applied to the integrated slice bound 4.10 (parent steps 3(c), 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ_j (j ∈ ℕ) be measures on ℝ^P, r₀ ∈ ℝ and Λ₀ ∈ [0, ∞) (NNReal). Assume μ_j(B_r) < ∞ for every j and every r ∈ ℝ, and μ_j(B_{r₀+1}) ≤ Λ₀ for every j, where B_r := ball(0, r). For t ∈ ℝ put D_j(t) := liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ_j({x : t − h < |x| < t}), the liminf along 𝓝[>]0 in [0, ∞]. Then there are t₀ ∈ (r₀, r₀ + 1), a strictly increasing φ : ℕ → ℕ and C ∈ [0, ∞) (NNReal) with D_{φ(j)}(t₀) ≤ C for every j.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (r₀ : ℝ) (Λ₀ : NNReal), (∀ (j : ℕ) (r : ℝ), μ j (ball (0 : Euclid P) r) < ∞) → (∀ j, μ j (ball (0 : Euclid P) (r₀ + 1)) ≤ (Λ₀ : ℝ≥0∞)) → ∃ t₀ ∈ Ioo r₀ (r₀ + 1), ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (C : NNReal), StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ j, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (φ j) {x : Euclid P | t₀ - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t₀}) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞)
